scripts.check: npm run check:toolchain && npm run check:alignment && npm run check:contract && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:dashboard && npm run check:app && npm run check:tools && npm run check:ops && npm run check:parity && npm run check:release
scripts.check:dashboard: npm --prefix finance-dashboard test && npm --prefix finance-dashboard run lint
scripts.check:app: npm --prefix finance-app test && npm --prefix finance-app run lint && node finance-app/scripts/verify-release-variant.js
scripts.check:ops: for file in ops/bin/*.sh; do bash -n "$file"; done && node --test ops/test/*.test.js
